issues.on_page: Line 45 Solid Waste 23,510.00, printed under 'Business-Type Activities' but in the General Fund column
issues.issue: Kept governmental because it sits in the General Fund column (figures and roll-forward tie). The form prints it under Business-Type Activities, so a person may want it treated as business-type. Defensible as recorded.

The capital outlay rule uses 'not itemized' unless an object is printed. 'Capital Improvements' arguably names an object (construction), so this is defensible. The same applies to detail[19] (Street 94,459) and detail[33] (Water 18,337).
